oi_initialization_evidence.reason: Backtest analysis snapshots omit strategy logs. No V3_AUDIT/V3_ENTRY logs pasted into code.
oi_initialization_evidence.frozen_source_expectation: Nominal OI uses six 4h initialization decisions once per session; independent WF restarts each fold, replay carries history across internal borders.
oi_initialization_evidence.boundary_return_convention: Equity monthly samples at next00:01 assigned by -61s; terminal actual balance override only at finish. Replay internal boundary funding may differ from finish-exclusive WF.
oi_initialization_evidence.pf_policy: PF calculated only from unique trades within each actual snapshot; never sum or average fold PF.

warnings: Synthetic rebasing is a comparator, not an executed account or financing replay.
Daily curve points are sampled evidence; no invented exact intraminute equity at funding.
Observed entry differences do not uniquely identify OI causality without per-decision logs.
